risk._comment: Ordered low to high. Jev's score type takes criteria as an ordered array of anchor descriptions, 2-10 entries.
anchors: Comments, formatting or whitespace only — no behaviour change
Local change to one function, fully covered by existing behaviour
Changes an interface, a default, or logic other code depends on
Touches persistence, concurrency, or error handling
Touches authentication, credentials, migrations, or deletion paths

phrasings.b: How much damage could this edit do if it is subtly wrong?
phrasings.c: How much scrutiny does this change deserve before shipping?
